tags.name: Data Contract
tags.description: APIs for managing Data Contracts, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and status tracking. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. All endpoints require authentication.

tags.name: DataError
tags.description: APIs for managing Data Errors (issues) detected in datasets. Provides endpoints for listing, deleting individual issues, and deleting all issues for a dataset. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering.

tags.name: Database
tags.description: APIs for managing databases. Provides CRUD operations for databases, including listing, retrieving by ID or name, creating, and retrieving datasets for a database. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering by datastore.

tags.name: Dataset
tags.description: CRUD Operations for Datasets, including metrics, watermarks, and quality configuration.

tags.name: Domain
tags.description: APIs for managing Domain entities. Provides endpoints for listing, retrieving, and creating domains. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. All endpoints require authentication.

tags.name: Browser Extension Config
tags.description: APIs for managing browser extension configuration. Provides endpoints for retrieving extension configuration for browser clients. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. All endpoints require authentication.

tags.name: Job Executions
tags.description: APIs for managing Job Execution entities. Provides endpoints for retrieving the last job execution for a dataset, listing job executions with pagination, and listing running job executions. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. All endpoints require authentication.

tags.name: Job
tags.description: APIs for managing jobs, including creation, retrieval, and status updates.

tags.name: Data Profile Task
tags.description: APIs for managing Data Profile Tasks. Provides endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting profile tasks associated with datasets. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. All endpoints require authentication.

tags.name: Data Quality Task
tags.description: APIs for managing Data Quality Tasks. Provides CRUD operations for quality tasks associated with datasets. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. Typical use cases include listing, creating, updating, deleting, and changing the status of quality tasks.

tags.name: Rule Task
tags.description: CRUD Operations for Rule Tasks. Provides endpoints to create, read, update, delete, and manage rule tasks associated with datasets.

tags.name: Catalog Search
tags.description: APIs for searching, autocompleting, and onboarding datasets from various catalog sources such as Kaggle and Google BigQuery. Provides endpoints for dataset search, autocomplete, and onboarding operations. All endpoints consume and produce application/json.

tags.name: Secret API collection
tags.description: APIs for managing secrets. Provides endpoints to create and retrieve secrets by key. All endpoints require authentication and proper authorization.

tags.name: User
tags.description: APIs for managing users, including CRUD operations, feedback, and user activity. All endpoints consume and produce JSON. Supports cursor-based pagination and role-based access control.

post.description: Creates a new secret or updates an existing secret for the specified key. Requires admin or secret management permissions.

parameters.name: secretkey
parameters.description: The key for the secret to create or update.

201.description: Secret created or updated successfully. The Location header contains the URI of the created/updated secret.

400.description: Bad request. Invalid secret key or content.

403.description: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions to create or update the secret.

409.description: Conflict. Secret with the given key already exists.

get.description: Fetches the secret value associated with the provided secret key. Requires appropriate permissions.

parameters.name: secretkey
parameters.description: The key of the secret to retrieve.

parameters.name: secretkey
parameters.description: The key of the secret to retrieve.

400.description: Invalid or missing secret key parameter.

403.description: Forbidden. Insufficient permissions to access the secret.

404.description: Secret not found for the provided key.

post.description: Submit feedback for the application. Feedback is associated with the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users. Supports cursor-based pagination using 'before' and 'after' query parameters. The 'limit' parameter controls the number of users returned per page. Optionally, use the 'fields' parameter to select specific fields (commented out).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return per page. Range: 1-1000. Default: 10.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns list of users before this cursor (for reverse paging).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Returns list of users after this cursor (for forward paging).

post.description: Create a new user. Only administrators are allowed to create users.

get.description: Retrieve a user by their unique identifier. Only the authenticated user can access their own user information.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the user.

200.description: The user with the specified ID.

404.description: User with the specified ID not found or not authorized.

delete.description: Deactivate a user by their ID. Users cannot be deleted, only deactivated. Only administrators are allowed to perform this operation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the user to deactivate.

404.description: User with the specified ID not found.

get.description: Retrieve a user by their unique name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name of the user.

200.description: The user with the specified name.

404.description: User with the specified name not found.
